title: Compromised backup administrator
narrative: At 07:40 UTC an attacker phishes the backup administrator and gains the 'backup-admin' role. That role can bypass governance-mode retention on the primary vault. The attacker deletes the two newest ERP recovery points, then tries and fails to delete a database copy in the isolated vault. The intrusion is detected at 09:00. No production system is down yet, but leadership must know which systems would still be recoverable if the attacker followed up with ransomware.

injections.description: Attacker obtained an active session for the backup-admin role through phishing.
Attacker deleted ERP recovery points using the governance-bypass permission.
Attacker attempted to delete the isolated copy of the orders database.

recommended_actions: Revoke backup-admin sessions manually through the identity provider
Treat every point in the primary vault as untrusted until it is re-verified
Re-verify primary-vault recovery points from a trusted workstation
Remove governance-bypass rights from standing roles
